LAREDO, Texas — U.S. Customs and Border Protection officers seized more than 3,395 pounds of suspected methamphetamine, valued at about $30.4 million, at the World Trade Bridge, the agency said. The seizure occurred Oct. 12 after an officer referred a 2020 International tractor-trailer, whose cargo was listed as salt, for inspection. A secondary inspection and X-ray examination found 76 bags of suspected methamphetamine among the cargo, according to CBP.
The driver, tractor and trailer were released. Homeland Security Investigations is investigating the seizure.
